state: native reads and opt-in master-only absolute available-stock writes; mocked tests only; live access/staging pending

authentication.addon: Shoptet-Access-Token; approved add-on, installed/authorized merchant and valid short-lived API token required; OAuth installation broker/automatic renewal not implemented

requests: GET /api/eshop; data.contactInformation.eshopId must match configured immutable ID
GET /api/stocks; all warehouses, numeric stock IDs
PATCH /api/stocks/{stockId}/movements with data:[{productCode: exact variant code, quantity: absolute amount available for ordering}]; one queued item per request
semantics: Variant code is SKU/product mapping key, numeric stock ID is warehouse key. amount copied directly as reported onHand; available unknown/null. Whole nonnegative units only. Nonzero claims refused pending reservation reconciliation/staging proof. observedAt is time of API observation, not a fabricated last stock change. No catalogue metadata inferred.
paging: Page starts at 1, metadata/count consistency and duplicates checked, stable totals/page size required, <=1000 pages/stock, <=100000 rows total. Not a transactional snapshot.
errors: Nonempty errors array rejected even with HTTP 200. Upstream messages never logged. HTTP 401/403/429/5xx use existing controlled errors and Retry-After governor.

writes.permission: Default read-only. read_write plus shoptetWriteAcknowledged=true required in desktop/CLI.
writes.mode: Master only. quantity means available for ordering. No relative amountChange or physical realStock emitted.
writes.preflight: Re-verify shop and exact item; require planned snapshot fingerprint and zero claim. Snapshot fingerprint is not an atomic server CAS.
writes.response: Reject any errors including HTTP 200; accept null success data only with verified matching stock read-back.
writes.recovery: Durable attempt recorded before IO; reconcile an already reached quantity without another PATCH, otherwise hold uncertain non-atomic retry.
writes.limitations: No atomic CAS/two-way or guarantee against concurrent sales between preflight and PATCH. Whole nonnegative zero-claim stock only. Merchant API access and staging required.

licensing: No LICENSE file found at inspected repository root. No upstream schema, examples, SDK or implementation is copied/bundled. Independently authored client and protocol summary only. Vendor/API/add-on terms and merchant permissions remain separate; no certification or entitlement inferred. Application licence remains undeclared.
